addresses.title: {name}: internet addresses
addresses.description: The addresses (IPs) this device has called from. Commands (sending people) go to trusted addresses only, and punches from an unknown address send no entry SMS.
addresses.none: The device has not called yet.
addresses.trustBody: Trust it only if you are sure it is your institute’s internet (for example, your connection changed). Its punches then count as looking right, entry SMS go out and people can be sent to the device.
addresses.revokeBody: The device gets no more commands (sending people) at this address, and punches from it send no entry SMS; they are flagged as a new IP.

guide.title: Setup guide: {name}
guide.description: Do these steps in the device’s menu. This page shows when the device connects.
guide.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy; write it down instead.
guide.step1: Connect the device to power and the internet (cable or Wi-Fi).
guide.step2: Press <v>M/OK</v> to open the menu, then open <v>Comm.</v> → <v>Cloud Server Setting</v> (<v>ADMS</v> on some models).
guide.step3: Enter <v>{host}</v> as <v>Server Address</v> and <v>{port}</v> as <v>Server Port</v>.
guide.step4Ip: Keep <v>Enable Domain Name</v> off: the address is an IP.
guide.step4Domain: Turn <v>Enable Domain Name</v> on: the address is a domain name.
guide.step6: Under <v>System</v> → <v>Date Time</v>, set the time zone to <v>GMT+6</v> and check the date and time.
guide.step7Both: This device takes both entry and exit, so under <v>Personalize</v> → <v>Punch State Options</v> turn on the automatic state by time: for example <v>Check-In</v> until 12 noon, then <v>Check-Out</v>.
guide.step8: Check the serial number under <v>System Info</v> → <v>Device Info</v>. It must be exactly <v>{serial}</v>; one different character and the device won’t connect.
guide.step9: Save, then switch the device off and on once.
guide.namesInEnglish: Names show on the device’s screen in English (the device cannot show Bangla letters).
guide.inactive: This device is switched off. Switch it on again from the list so it can connect.
guide.waitingHint: Once the steps are done, the device connects by itself and it shows here. Keep this page open.
guide.offlineHint: The device has connected before but is not calling now. Check its power and internet; this shows by itself when it is back.
guide.fromAddress: The device connected from <v>{ip}</v>. Is this your institute’s internet connection?
guide.notOursHint: If not, stop trusting it: no commands go to that address, and punches from it send no entry SMS.
guide.trustHint: Trust it if it is your institute’s; until then people can’t be sent to the device.
